sentences.text: In the fourth volume, the series is revealed to be set in the same fictional universe as Ennis's previous 1995–2000 DC Vertigo series, Preacher, with former vampire Proinsias Cassidy cameoing as a bartender.

[...] [It] feels uniquely mapped as a spin-off that doesn't rely on cameos from [its predecessor] to assure relevance or importance." Alec Bojalad of Den of Geek gave it a rating of 4 out of 5 stars and wrote, "Ultimately, Gen V doesn't appear to be striving for greatness but for something just as elusive.
